column6: HH -1SC NORMAL HOUSEHOLDS HEADED BY SCHEDULED CASTES BY HOUSEHOLD SIZE (Census 2011)

column1: Notes: i)  A household is treated as a Scheduled Caste household when the head of the household belongs to a Scheduled Caste.
ii)  Households other than Institutional and Houseless households are Normal households.
iii)  Household size refers to number of persons in a household.

iv)  Population in HH-1SC Table has been arrived at taking into account all the persons in SC headed household irrespective of their SC status, therefore it will not match with SC population given in PCA.
